name: ecamm-mcp
description: Run Ecamm Live from Claude: scenes, overlays, audio, sound effects, markers, go live and record.
long_description:
Lets Claude control Ecamm Live on this Mac through Ecamm's own Remote Control feature (the one Stream Deck and Companion use). Type what you want: check your setup before a show, ask for a scene by name, show or hide overlays, mute and set volumes, fire sound effects, drop markers, run Ecamm for Zoom, and start or stop a broadcast or recording.

The first time Claude connects to Ecamm Live, Ecamm asks "Claude (ecamm-mcp) Wants To Control Ecamm". Click Allow.

Anything that goes on air (go live, end, record, public comments) is a dry run until you confirm it. Community project, best effort, not affiliated with Ecamm Network. No live-show support. Questions go to the project's GitHub Discussions, not to Ecamm.

recording_folder.title: Recording folder (optional)
recording_folder.description: Full path to the folder on this Mac containing recordings you want the assistant to inspect. Leave blank to disable media-file access.

ffprobe.title: Media inspector location (optional)
ffprobe.description: Full path to an installed ffprobe executable. Required for media inspection if ffprobe is not already available to the app. Ecamm controls work without it.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Claude can see status and lists but can't change anything. Good for a show you don't want touched.

hostname.title: Ecamm on another Mac (optional)
hostname.description: Leave blank when Ecamm Live runs on this Mac. Otherwise the other Mac's name, like Mac-Mini.local.

tools.name: ecamm_preflight
tools.description: Pre-show check: problems Ecamm can see, what it could not read, and what it does not check

tools.name: ecamm_prepare_session
tools.description: Read-only preparation report for a recording, stream or presentation

tools.name: ecamm_plan_cue
tools.description: Check a short list of preparation steps without running them

tools.name: ecamm_run_cue
tools.description: Run up to 12 preparation steps in order; cannot go live, record or end

tools.name: ecamm_set_overlay_text
tools.description: Change the text of an existing overlay

tools.name: ecamm_read_markers
tools.description: Read the marker file saved beside a recording

tools.name: ecamm_scene_sheet
tools.description: One labeled picture of every scene, for checking your setup from anywhere

tools.name: ecamm_refresh_scene_sheet
tools.description: Switch through every scene to get current pictures, then return to where you were

tools.name: ecamm_status
tools.description: Live or not, current scene, viewers, mutes and volumes

tools.name: ecamm_switch_scene
tools.description: Take a scene live by name

tools.name: ecamm_set_mute
tools.description: Mute or unmute the mic or any audio bus

tools.name: ecamm_add_marker
tools.description: Drop a marker in the recording

tools.name: ecamm_start_stop
tools.description: Go live, record, or end (asks for confirmation)
